operator.description:
An optional operator to evaluate the resolved {@link #produceSubject} value against the
{@link #value}. The subject value will be on the left hand side of the operator,
${subject} < ${value} where operator is LESS_THAN.

param.description: The UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam that contains the value to extract

title: Implements UiSdlRenderCondition for component rendering based on a {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam} value.
name: UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParamCondition
